scripts.build:remotes: npm run --prefix apps/domains-ui build && npm run --prefix apps/search-ui build && npm run --prefix apps/ingestion-ui build && npm run --prefix apps/admin-ui build
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n domains,search,ingestion,admin,shell "npm run --prefix apps/domains-ui dev" "npm run --prefix apps/search-ui dev" "npm run --prefix apps/ingestion-ui dev" "npm run --prefix apps/admin-ui dev" "npm run --prefix apps/shell dev"
scripts.dev:all:preview: npm run build:remotes && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n domains,search,ingestion,admin,shell "npm run --prefix apps/domains-ui preview" "npm run --prefix apps/search-ui preview" "npm run --prefix apps/ingestion-ui preview" "npm run --prefix apps/admin-ui preview" "npm run --prefix apps/shell dev"
